Name: Shirtless Alex
Author: bluestarkiller
Description:
This is an edit of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/392/?]JepMZ Shirtless (Optional) improved muscular Alex sprite replacement
[/url]
I am a fan of his mod but the body still looked rather muddy and the hair wasn't completely solid so I cleaned up the stray pixels and changed a few sprites that still had a shirt on such as when he's throwing the ball, all poses are now shirtless except when he's at the restaurant on his 10 heart event, he wears a t-shirt for that.

Make sure to also download [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/399?]JepMZ Shirtless Alex Portraits[/url]!
